list.description: Sidekicks are tagged skill packages. Phase tags determine which phase a Sidekick can run; any other tag is free-form. Built-in packages can be customized — editing one creates a copy in your user layer without touching the original.
list.noSidekicksDescription: Create a Sidekick package to customize how a phase runs
list.noSidekicksMatchDescription: Clear the filter to see all Sidekicks

form.builtInWarning: This is a built-in Sidekick. Saving changes will copy it into your user layer — the built-in original stays untouched, and this package will no longer receive built-in updates.
form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only. Consider a distinct persona name for custom Sidekicks (e.g. "robin", "falcon") rather than a literal description.
form.tagsHint: planning/implementing/reviewing/testing/pushing are phase tags (only Sidekicks carrying a phase tag can be assigned to that phase). No phase tag = a general-purpose Sidekick (e.g. issue creation). Type a tag and press Enter, or click a suggestion below.
form.addPhaseTagHint: Add a phase tag (planning/implementing/reviewing/testing/pushing) to make this Sidekick eligible as a default.
form.skillBodyHint: Markdown body of the skill package (frontmatter is managed above). Supports {{task.*}} / {{project.*}} / {{module.*}} / {{sidekick.*}} template variables.
form.scriptsDescription: Executable files placed under scripts/. Can only be set at creation time.

validation.nameFormat: Name must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
validation.invalidTag: Invalid tag "{{tag}}": must start with a lowercase letter or digit and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens

confirm.copyBuiltInMessage: This Sidekick is built-in. Saving will create a copy in your user layer — future built-in updates to "{{name}}" will no longer affect it. Continue?
confirm.revertMessage: Revert "{{name}}" to the built-in version? Your customizations will be discarded.
confirm.deleteMessage: Delete Sidekick "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
